sloka: शतक्रतुमुखैर्देवैः श्रूयते न पराजितः ।महात्मा बलसम्पन्नो रावणो लोकरावणः ।। ६.११४.१०० ।।
transliteration: śatakratumukhairdevaiḥ śrūyate na parājitaḥ ।mahātmā balasampanno rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.114.100 ।।

translations.english: "This nightranger is full of unrighteousness and untrue. But he was a strong, energetic hero in combat."
